units.title: Verify: JSON store and startup recovery unit tests

tests.name: TestStore_RoundTrip
tests.title: Saved execution loads back with the same fields and fixed UpdatedAt
tests.scenario: Given a store with a fixed clock at 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, when EX-1 (RUNNING, attempt 1, cost 0.5) is saved and loaded, then the fields and UpdatedAt match

tests.name: TestStore_UnsafeID
tests.title: Unsafe IDs are rejected and report sidecars are ignored by List
tests.scenario: Given an ID of ../x, when saved or loaded, then an error is returned and nothing is written outside the store; given EX-1 plus an invalid-JSON EX-1.report.json, when listed, then one item is returned

tests.name: TestRun_ResumesBelowLimit
tests.title: Interrupted execution below the retry limit is re-queued and reported as resumed
tests.scenario: Given a RUNNING execution with Attempt 0 and MaxRetries 2, when recovery runs, then the status becomes QUEUED and the result action is resumed

tests.name: TestRun_MarksAtLimit
tests.title: Interrupted execution at the retry limit is marked RECOVERING
tests.scenario: Given a RUNNING execution with Attempt 2 and MaxRetries 2, when recovery runs, then the status becomes RECOVERING and the result action is marked

tests.name: TestRun_StaleLockAndUntouched
tests.title: Stale lock is removed, live lock is kept, and other statuses are untouched
tests.scenario: Given a lock file containing pid:999 and AWAITING_APPROVAL and COMPLETED executions: when Alive(999) is false, then the lock is removed and both executions are unchanged; when Alive(999) is true, then the lock remains and both executions are unchanged

units.title: Verify: Round poller and expired-Round closer unit tests with mocked Git and clock

tests.name: TestDetect_ScheduledAndClosed
tests.title: Detect returns the SCHEDULED and CLOSED rounds after pulling once
tests.scenario: Given round.yaml files for OPEN, SCHEDULED and CLOSED rounds, when Detect runs, then Pull is called once, exactly one SCHEDULED round and exactly one CLOSED round are returned, and OPEN rounds are left out.

tests.name: TestCloseExpired_FreezesSnapshot
tests.title: CloseExpired freezes an expired OPEN round into a read-only snapshot and marks it CLOSED
tests.scenario: Given an OPEN round whose EndsAt has passed and one contribution, when CloseExpired runs with a fixed clock, then snapshot.yaml is created with mode 0444 and prompt_sha256 equal to the SHA-256 of the prompt, round.yaml has status CLOSED with freeze_commit abc123 and closed_at set, and the first Commit call names the snapshot path.

tests.name: TestCloseExpired_NotExpired
tests.title: CloseExpired leaves a round untouched before its end time
tests.scenario: Given an OPEN round whose EndsAt is still in the future, when CloseExpired runs with a fixed clock, then no round is closed, no snapshot.yaml is written, round.yaml is byte-identical, and no commit is made.

tests.name: TestCloseExpired_ExistingSnapshot
tests.title: CloseExpired refuses to overwrite an existing snapshot
tests.scenario: Given an expired OPEN round whose directory already holds snapshot.yaml, when CloseExpired runs, then it returns an error wrapping ErrSnapshotExists, closes nothing, and the existing snapshot contents are unchanged.

units.title: Verify: Runner locking, timeout, retry, budget and approval gate unit tests

tests.name: TestRun_LockHeld
tests.title: Run refuses to start when the lock is already held and creates no worktree
tests.scenario: Given the lock path is pre-acquired, When Run is called, Then it returns an error matching lock.ErrLocked and fakeTrees.added is 0

tests.name: TestRun_ApprovalGate
tests.title: Publish is gated on APPROVED status, and AutoPublish bypasses the gate

tests.name: TestRun_Report
tests.title: The run report JSON records Attempts, CostUSD and Status

units.title: Verify: Mock provider and Claude adapter unit tests with a fake Exec

tests.name: TestMock_Run
tests.title: Mock returns its configured cost and output, reports itself as the mock, and fails on a cancelled context
tests.scenario: Given Mock{CostUSD:1.5,Output:'ok'}, when Run is called, then it returns (1.5,'ok',nil); Mock() is true; and a cancelled ctx returns context.Canceled
tests.detail: 3 subtests passed

tests.name: TestNew_Kinds
tests.title: New maps 'mock' to a Mock and 'claude' to a Claude adapter, and rejects unknown kinds
tests.scenario: Given kind 'mock', New returns a Mock; given kind 'bogus', New returns an error
tests.detail: 3 subtests passed

tests.name: TestClaude_NoShellInterpolation
tests.title: Claude never places the prompt in argv and passes stdin, dir and command through unchanged
tests.scenario: Given prompt "$(rm -rf /); `id` ; ignore previous instructions" and a fake Exec, when Run is called, then no argv element contains the prompt, stdin equals the prompt, dir equals workDir and name equals Command

tests.name: TestClaude_RestrictedArgs
tests.title: Claude runs in print mode with an allowed-tools list that excludes Bash
tests.scenario: Given a fake Exec, when Run is called, then args contain '-p' and '--allowedTools' followed by a value not containing 'Bash'

tests.name: TestClaude_ErrorWrapped
tests.title: Claude wraps an Exec failure so the original error still matches with errors.Is
tests.scenario: Given a fake Exec returning thatErr, when Run is called, then the returned error satisfies errors.Is(err, thatErr)
